officialLinks.label: Grade scale; GPA formula; P/D/F; GPA scope
University grading scales and school differences

helpIntro: For Columbia College undergraduates, GPA is credit-weighted on a 4.33 scale: A+=4.33, A=4.00, A-=3.67 through F=0. Enter Columbia points/credits and final grades for a planning estimate.
helpNote: This profile is for Columbia College, not every Columbia school. P, W, R and temporary marks are excluded; D and F remain GPA-bearing under Pass/D/Fail. Repeat Impact is disabled because retake treatment is conditional.
helpExample: A 4-credit A earns 16.00 grade points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.99; 25.99 ÷ 7 = 3.713.

gradeExplanations.P: Pass is excluded from GPA. Under Columbia College Pass/D/Fail, C- or higher is covered by P; D or F remains letter-graded and GPA-bearing.
gradeExplanations.AR: Temporary administrative mark; wait for a final grade.
gradeExplanations.AR YC: Temporary year-course mark; wait for the final grade.
gradeExplanations.YC: Year-course notation; excluded until a qualitative grade is assigned.
gradeExplanations.IN: Incomplete; excluded until replaced by a final grade.
gradeExplanations.R: Registration credit; no academic credit and no GPA value.

specialTypes.name: Columbia College / Columbia-owned course
specialTypes.note: Use for standard letter-graded coursework that appears in the Columbia College GPA, including Columbia-sponsored study abroad.

specialTypes.name: External transfer or non-Columbia study abroad
specialTypes.note: Eligible outside credit may count toward the degree but its grade is not included in the Columbia College GPA.

specialTypes.name: Course/record using another Columbia school grading system
specialTypes.note: Columbia schools can use different grading systems. Confirm the transcript grade and your school’s GPA rules before calculating.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is disabled. Columbia College repeat treatment depends on the first attempt and degree-credit context; confirm the record in Vergil/with advising before modeling a retake.
